trigger: Merging a retry of an earlier-wave unit after a later-wave unit that wrote the same file produced validator I63-2 rows that cannot be accepted (DECISIONS #46(2), #48).
lesson: The end-of-run check orders writers by graph wave, not by merge time; a later merge from an earlier wave reads as 'changed after the later unit was verified'.
how_to_apply: Route a fix to a shared file through the LATER-wave unit that owns it (or merge the earlier unit's retry before the later unit merges), and when two units' frames share a file make the dependency explicit in the graph.
